title: Fixed GIF detection for image URL variants
summary: Architecture: the image card checks the file type before showing image editing. Problem: checking the full URL misses GIF files with a query string, fragment, or uppercase extension. Solution: inspect the path before query and fragment with a case-insensitive GIF suffix check.
validation: Regression cases cover .gif, .GIF, queries and fragments, plus non-GIF paths whose query mentions .gif. This detects URL extensions, not file contents.
